---
name: Bug report
about: Report a gameplay, graphics, audio or build issue
---

Describe the problem and steps to reproduce it. Include the expected result.

- Commit/build:
- OS version, CPU, GPU and driver:
- USA/Europe disc and D3D11/Vulkan renderer:
- F1 settings and controller:
- Screen or gameplay location:

Attach only a short, redacted log excerpt if needed. Remove personal paths and
account information. Do not upload ISOs, extracted files, generated game code,
saves, or playable binaries.

For a Windows native crash on v0.4.3 or later, include the `[graphics]`,
`[native-crash]` and `[launcher]` lines from
`%LOCALAPPDATA%\Sims2PSPRecomp\logs\latest.log`, if present. These identify the
faulting module and driver; they do not require sharing a memory dump.
